description: This Java class 'TestSupportFactory' provides factory methods for creating and persisting test data entities such as products, categories, countries, currencies, languages, merchant stores, product types, and manufacturers. It appears tailored for setting up and mocking complex data scenarios in unit or integration tests within the sales management system.

classes.name: TestSupportFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing factory methods for generating and persisting test data entities used in sales management system tests.

methods.name: createAndStoreRandomProduct
methods.description: Creates and stores a product with randomized attributes, including descriptions, availability, and pricing, linked to specified manufacturer, category, store, and language.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a category with random description names, associating it with a parent category if provided, for testing category hierarchies.

methods.name: createCountry
methods.description: Creates a country entity with descriptive details, particularly for testing geographical data setup.

methods.name: createCurrency
methods.description: Creates a currency entity based on the CAD locale, supported for use in multi-currency scenarios.

methods.name: createLanguage
methods.description: Creates a language object given a language code, used to set language contexts in test data.

methods.name: createMerchantStore
methods.description: Creates a merchant store entity with specified details to simulate store entities involved in transactions.

methods.name: createProductType
methods.description: Creates a default product type for categorizing products in test scenarios.

methods.name: createRandomManufacturer
methods.description: Creates a manufacturer with a randomized name, linked to a store and language, for diverse manufacturer scenarios.
